The University of Melbourne, Commerce Undergraduate International Merit Scholarship 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for undergraduate applicants. The scholarship aims to support international students commencing the Bachelor of Commerce. The selected students will receive a 50% fee remission for the duration of the course (up to 300 points).
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Have completed an approved year 12 program or equivalent that meets the eligibility requirements for the Bachelor of Commerce
Be made an unconditional offer for the Bachelor of Commerce
The selected students will receive a 50% fee remission for the duration of the course (up to 300 points).

No application required. Eligible candidates will be automatically considered for this award if they meet the eligibility criteria.
The selection is made based on academic merit.
A total of 10 scholarships are awarded under this scheme.
Successful applicants will be notified by email with the scholarship offer letter. Unsuccessful applicants will not be contacted.
